text: My clearing condition is price, not volume: a daily close above the 20-day high. Today TOST is still inside its reaction - W 6.8% under the 20-wk high, D 3.8% under the 20-day high, H1 at 14% of range - and close_above:bar_high buys a bounce in that reaction, not C5's confirming new high. 'Once volume expands' is not my test: day_vol 1.02 is a proxy, fill difficulty NOT_SERVED (R5), so I name no volume level. The ticket should adopt close_above the 20-day high; until it prints I stand aside.
